blocks.prompt: 7. The rate of population growth of a small city (in people per year) is modeled by \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\), where \(t\) is the number of years after 2025. If the population in 2025 (\(t = 0\)) was 25,000 people: (a) Find the population function \(P(t)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan aabadi barhne ka rate diya hai; aabadi khud us rate ka antiderivative hai.
Diya kya hai? \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\) aur 2025 mein (\(t = 0\)) 25000 log.
Plan: rate ko integrate karo, phir \(P(0) = 25000\) se constant nikaalo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\), \(P(0) = 25000\).
Maloom karna: \(P(t)\).
Tareeqa: rate ko integrate karna, phir \(P(0)\) lagana.

\(P(0) = 25000\) lagayein
\[25000 = 0 + 0 + C \Rightarrow C = 25000\]
\[P(t) = 25000 + 800t + 30t^{2}\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par sirf \(C\) bachta hai, yani \(C\) 2025 ki aabadi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key function ko "\(P(r) = 25000 + 800t + 30t^{2}\)" chhapti hai; variable \(t\) hai: \(P(t) = 25000 + 800t + 30t^{2}\).

blocks.prompt: 7. The rate of population growth of a small city (in people per year) is modeled by \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\), where \(t\) is the number of years after 2025. If the population in 2025 (\(t = 0\)) was 25,000 people: (b) Estimate the population in 2035.
blocks.explanation:
Saal ko pehle \(t\) mein badlo, phir \(P(t)\) mein rakho.
Diya kya hai? Part (a) ka \(P(t)\); \(t\) 2025 ke baad ke saal ginta hai.
Plan: 2035 matlab \(t = 10\); \(P(10)\) nikaalo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P(t) = 25000 + 800t + 30t^{2}\), \(t\) = 2025 ke baad ke saal.
Maloom karna: 2035 mein aabadi.
Tareeqa: 2035 matlab \(t = 2035 - 2025 = 10\).

Tasdeeq
Das saal mein kul izafa \(\int_{0}^{10}(800 + 60t)\,dt = 8000 + 3000 = 11000\), aur \(25000 + 11000 = 36000\;\checkmark\).

blocks.prompt: 7. The rate of population growth of a small city (in people per year) is modeled by \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\), where \(t\) is the number of years after 2025. If the population in 2025 (\(t = 0\)) was 25,000 people: (c) Calculate the total population growth from 2028 to 2033.
blocks.explanation:
Do saalon ke darmiyan kul izafa = baad wali aabadi minus pehle wali, ya seedha rate ka definite integral.
Diya kya hai? Rate \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\).
Plan: 2028 matlab \(t = 3\), 2033 matlab \(t = 8\); \(\int_{3}^{8} P'(t)\,dt\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P'(t) = 800 + 60t\).
Maloom karna: 2028 (\(t = 3\)) se 2033 (\(t = 8\)) tak izafa.
Tareeqa: \(\int_{3}^{8} P'(t)\,dt = P(8) - P(3)\).

Rate ko integrate karein
\[\int_{3}^{8}(800 + 60t)\,dt = \big[800t + 30t^{2}\big]_{3}^{8}\]
\[= (6400 + 1920) - (2400 + 270)\]
\[= 8320 - 2670 = 5650\]
Kyun: Fundamental Theorem ke mutabiq rate ka integral kul tabdeeli hai. \(30 \times 64 = 1920\), \(30 \times 9 = 270\). Definite integral mein constant \(C\) khud cancel ho jata hai.
